ingredients: Important information Directions 1. Remove the toy from its packaging. 2. Place the toy on a flat surface. 3. Press the 'ON' button to start the game. 4. Follow the voice prompts to play the selected game mode (Spell, Mystery, Say It, Secret Code, or Letter). 5. Use the keypad to input the correct spellings or responses. 6. Repeat until the game is complete or the user decides to switch game modes or turn off the toy.
key_features: Retro Play: Relive the classic fun of the 80s with Speak & Spell! This toy may be new, but it has all the iconic graphics, sounds, and gameplay you remember
5 Play Modes: Enjoy hours of educational fun with 5 Play Modes! Spell, Mystery, Say It, Secret Code, and Letter—which game will you play today
Multiple Challenge Levels: Ready to up your game? Choose from different challenge levels as you learn and play! Can you reach the highest level
Great Gift For Kids: Speak & Spell makes a fun, educational gift for kids ages 7 and up
